# Yahoo UK

> > Yahoo UK is a comprehensive news and information portal delivering UK and international news, finance, sports, lifestyle content, and essential web services including mail and weather.

Yahoo UK serves as the British edition of the global Yahoo network, providing aggregated news coverage from sources like AFP and RFI, alongside original lifestyle content from Yahoo Life UK and partnerships with publishers like House Beautiful and BuzzFeed. The platform offers integrated access to email, search, weather forecasts, and personalized content for UK audiences.

## Key Topics

- Yahoo
- UK news
- International news
- News portal
- Aggregated content
- Yahoo Life UK
